Zombi West is a Run and Gun video game developed and published by Silas Borges Heat made the OpenBor engine. The game was released at the end of 2017 through a test version.

This video game tells the story a human survivor who lives in the distant west and fights against the zombies forces that are razing the earth. As one of the few human beings who survived the initial attack, the player should survive horror at lead tip such as the law of the old west.
